before: An online marketplace is the site that brings together buyers and sellers, making a fee for their service. It works on a transaction based economics, delivery density and repeat purchases. Gross merchandise value (GMV) is a measure of the value of goods sold and not of the revenues generated by the platform.
after: An online marketplace is the site that brings together buyers and sellers, earning commission and service fees. Its economics depend on completed transactions, delivery density and repeat purchases. Gross merchandise value (GMV) is a measure of the value of goods sold and not of the revenues generated by the platform.

before: The digital access market is there for Jordan, but it would not be enough to build infrastructure to have a profitable customer base. This is as important as traffic to your website, as it is with regard to fulfilment performance.
after: The digital access market is there for Jordan, but it would not be enough to build infrastructure to have a profitable customer base. A new player must persuade shoppers to switch from existing websites and physical shops. Broad assortments will only be of value if there are acceptable delivery costs and reliability and returns. This is as important as traffic to your website, as it is with regard to fulfilment performance.

The other e-commerce page on its website quotes an older tax rate of 16% of the valuation on personal parcels (ITA, 2026a); and the current Arabic version of the FAQ on Jordan Customs website says that the current tax rate on personal parcels is 16% of the valuation, if the parcels qualify (Jordan Customs, n.d.). They are not commercial tariff schedules, as is often mistakenly thought, but personal-parcel rules. Have written HS code and origin evaluation before pricing.
after: Importation of all commercial items is required to be registered, documented and approved. Importer-card and customs requirements are described by the United States International Trade Administration (ITA, 2026b). Its e-commerce page quotes 10% with a JOD 5 minimum for personal parcels below JOD 200 (ITA, 2026a). The Arabic Jordan Customs FAQ gives 16% for qualifying personal parcels (Jordan Customs, n.d.). They are not commercial tariff schedules, as is often mistakenly thought, but personal-parcel rules. Have written HS code and origin evaluation before pricing.

before: Jordan's tax tables indicate that there is a 16% general rate, plus any exemptions (ISTD, n.d.). Non-recoverable taxes are not included in revenues in the model, the price of products should include non-recoverable taxes. Consumer protection law No. 7 of 2017 – Accurate information and redress. Seek redress at a local level on issues of complaint or broken.
after: Jordan's tax tables indicate a 16% general rate, with exemptions and other rates (Income and Sales Tax Department [ISTD], n.d.). Non-recoverable taxes are not included in revenues in the model, the price of products should include non-recoverable taxes. Consumer protection law No. 7 of 2017 – Accurate information and redress. Seek redress at a local level on issues of complaint or broken.

before: Jordan's tax tables indicate a 16% general rate, with exemptions and other rates (Income and Sales Tax Department [ISTD], n.d.). Non-recoverable taxes are not included in revenues in the model, the price of products should include non-recoverable taxes. Consumer protection law No. 7 of 2017 – Accurate information and redress. Seek redress at a local level on issues of complaint or broken.
after: Jordan's tax tables indicate a 16% general rate, with exemptions and other rates (Income and Sales Tax Department [ISTD], n.d.). Recoverable taxes are pass-through amounts. Product prices must cover non-recoverable import charges. Consumer Protection Law No. 7 of 2017 requires accurate information and redress (WIPO, 2017). Provide local complaint and remedy procedures.

before: Locate a reputable retailer selling certain items at a predictable price on the day of the year.Suppose that there is a reliable store that sells some of the same goods at a constant rate throughout the day (noon). Avoid giving assurances of the lowest price or fast delivery unless you can present evidence.
after: Position noon as a reliable retailer of selected goods with predictable landed prices. Avoid giving assurances of the lowest price or fast delivery unless you can present evidence.

before: This is an approach with an associated governance cost. Consequently, there should be adequate avenues for rejecting products that are not appropriate, or for canceling campaigns when they are not appropriate, as well as regular financial and safety regulations for regional teams. Reach an agreement on those decision rights prior to pilot. Otherwise, it is possible that campaigning may be standardised, creating a demand which the local service may not be able to keep up with. The strategic decision is made not just because Jordan is an attractive neighbouring market, it's made because of these operating pressures.
after: This is an approach with an associated governance cost. The Jordan team needs authority to reject unsuitable products and cancel campaigns, within common financial and safety rules. Reach an agreement on those decision rights prior to pilot. Otherwise, it is possible that campaigning may be standardised, creating a demand which the local service may not be able to keep up with. The strategic decision is made not just because Jordan is an attractive neighbouring market, it's made because of these operating pressures.

before: Use a positive contribution level for all promoted baskets. Depending on how much commission you can make, a lower sale price may mean that you will sell more and then you will have less commission income, so this should be taken into consideration when approving the campaign, keeping in mind the expected contribution after paying commission as well as the fulfilment costs. The more it becomes clear what the delivery charge is, the less low value orders will be placed, but if it is a subsidy, then the export economics only get worse with its application over the long term. Only test minimum basket incentives in a capped marketing allowance.
after: Use a positive contribution level for all promoted baskets. A lower sale price reduces commission per order, even if volume increases. Approve campaigns against expected commission income after payment and fulfilment costs. The more it becomes clear what the delivery charge is, the less low value orders will be placed, but if it is a subsidy, then the export economics only get worse with its application over the long term. Only test minimum basket incentives in a capped marketing allowance.

before: If demand is substantial enough to justify keeping inventory on the local level, a JV offers both local expertise and accountability for operations as well as joint investment. But licensing gives fewer safeguards for the service, demands greater investment and is subject to ownership limits. Pure exporting flexibility is retained but there is a delivery disadvantage. All these factors (Cengage Learning, 2017b, slides 7-11) are taken into consideration in the staged selection.
after: If demand is substantial enough to justify keeping inventory on the local level, a JV offers both local expertise and accountability for operations as well as joint investment. Licensing gives fewer safeguards for service quality. A wholly owned operation demands greater investment and is subject to ownership limits. Pure exporting flexibility is retained but there is a delivery disadvantage. All these factors (Cengage Learning, 2017b, slides 7-11) are taken into consideration in the staged selection.

before: The JV should begin with a small fulfilment area, and only store the fastest selling products on consignment. Replenishment would be dictated by what is sold and agreed stock. It also demands correct stock visibility, to ensure that the customer does not assume that it is there for them to pick up as soon as it is ordered.

before: The model is based on a net order with commission as a percentage of gross orders and will only count orders when refunds are made. It handles reserve also extra failed delivery, return costs, so that no refunded goods will be reported as losses of revenue. The levy on goods collected for authorities and proceeds from seller are not considered to be platform income. If contracts were made noon the principal seller, the impact to revenue recognition and on inventory exposure and working capital requirements would be material. It will take new revenue, working-capital and risk assumptions to make that change.
after: The model counts completed, paid orders net of goods refunds, with commission based on net goods GMV. The extra reserve covers failed delivery and return handling without counting goods refunds twice. The levy on goods collected for authorities and proceeds from seller are not considered to be platform income. If contracts were made noon the principal seller, the impact to revenue recognition and on inventory exposure and working capital requirements would be material. It will take new revenue, working-capital and risk assumptions to make that change.

before: Check cash and contribution, weekly. If the per-order contribution is negative in the system, terminate the acquisition; if the customs treatment is not decided then suspend acquisition of the impacted products. In the event that there is a disruption to the borders, there should be revised delivery promises offered and refunds should be given to customers who are not legally and costed to provide alternate delivery routes. Counsellors should notify of a data incident and response should be immediate to contain and evaluate the data incident. If JV gates fail, then either run a viable small export service or close the service, pay the merchants and return the money to the customer. The owners and review triggers are set in exhibit 7.
after: Check cash and contribution, weekly. If the per-order contribution is negative in the system, terminate the acquisition; if the customs treatment is not decided then suspend acquisition of the impacted products. If borders are disrupted, revise delivery promises and offer refunds unless a lawful, costed alternative route is available. Contain data incidents immediately and seek advice on assessment and notification. If JV gates fail, then either run a viable small export service or close the service, pay the merchants and return the money to the customer. The owners and review triggers are set in exhibit 7.
